attributes.name: Unholy Aspergillum +3
attributes.powers:
If this card has the Corrupted trait, a character at your location must discard a blessing or you may not play this card.

For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d8+3; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d4+1. If the bane has the Outsider or Undead trait, you may additionally recharge a card that has the Divine trait to add another 1d8.
